# The listings of the SHARED temp directory this repository still permits, one
# `file:function` per line, each with its reason. A test that lists
# os.TempDir() reads a directory every other job on the same self-hosted runner
# writes to: a sibling's entry appearing mid-test reddens the run for something it
# did not do. The rule is to give the tool a temp root option defaulting to
# os.TempDir(), pass t.TempDir() from the test, and read that directory instead.
#
# This list is checked in BOTH directions by sharedtemp_class_test.go -- an
# unlisted finding is a red run, and a listed entry that no longer names one is
# also a red run -- so it can only ever shrink.
#
# It is EMPTY, and that is the point: the one offender the rule found when it
# landed (internal/review/mutate_test.go's
# TestMutateRemovesItsWorktreeOnBothPaths, red four times in one night -- #1341
# twice, #1345, #1360) was fixed rather than listed.
